title: SDK backport configuration
description: Per-repo configuration for camunda/sdk-infra's sdk-backport.yml. Lives at .github/backport.yml and is read from the backport's TARGET branch, so each stable line describes its own generator. A target branch without the file fails the regeneration for that backport (the workflow will not guess generated paths).

language.description: Passed to actions/setup-sdk-toolchain before regenerating. Omit it when the repo's language is not supported there; the repo's .github/actions/codegen-setup action (if present on the target branch) then does all of the setup.

generated-paths.description: Committed files and directories derived from the upstream spec or the generator, as repo-relative paths (no globs; they are passed to `git restore` as pathspecs). On each backport branch they are restored from the target branch and regenerated. An empty list turns regeneration off.

regenerate.description: Shell command, run from the repo root with bash, that regenerates generated-paths from the committed spec. It must not refetch the upstream spec: the target branch's committed copy is the input. Required when generated-paths is non-empty.

do-not-backport.description: Paths that must never be cherry-picked onto this target branch, e.g. a generator that diverged between stable/9 and stable/10. If the backport changes a matching path, regeneration is skipped and the bot asks for the backport PR to be closed or reduced.

paths.description: Globs: `**` matches across directories, `*` within one; a pattern without `/` matches the file name at any depth.

from.description: Source branches (the base of the original PR) this rule applies to. Omitted = any source.
